test_elementwise: test the pz.nn.Elementwise layer with jax.nn.relu activation on a named-shape array
test_softmax: test the pz.nn.Softmax layer over specified named dimensions on a multi-dimensional array
create_elementwise_layer: create a pz.nn.Elementwise layer wrapping a JAX activation function like relu
create_softmax_layer: create a pz.nn.Softmax layer applying softmax over specified named dimensions
check_array_structure: check the named shape structure of a Penzai array result using pz.chk.check_structure
